text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is the winner! She has
finally earned
the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon, you're amazing! You're
the best!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Go, Hishi Amazon! You've reached the
very
summit of the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hell yeeeeeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The resounding applause from the
audience rings
on for what feels like
forever.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent race!
Congratulations on
winning the Triple
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks a lot! I feel awesome after
running
the best one-on-one of my life!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But... I couldn't have gotten this far all
on my
own.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I had someone who wrote specialized
training
booklets thicker than a brick for
me, and who
even hiked up mountains
with me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And that somebody is my trusty partner,

<username>.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was only able come this far with your
help. Now
I'm ready to take
you-know-who on with my head
held
high.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues to talk after addressing
me, and
every camera in the room is
completely fixated on
her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But my journey isn't over yet. My
one-on-ones are
just getting started.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's someone in the Twinkle Series that I just have to face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The room is stirred into a frenzy just by
her name
alone. After all, she's a beast
of a runner who's
currently taking the
world by storm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Thing is, I realized last year that I
wasn't good
enough yet to put up a
decent fight.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I made the decision to take on the
Tiara tour
and make myself even better!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And now, I've won the Triple Tiara and
finally
reached a level I can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm ready, it's time to declare
total war
on Narita Brian and give her a
run for her money!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Does this mean your next race will
be—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! It's gonna be the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like we're in for the dramatic
clash
everyone's been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
If Narita Brian wins the Triple Crown...
we'll be in
for a match for the ages!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
While we've got the camera rolling, is
there
anything you want to tell Narita
Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon looks directly at the
camera, her
eyes absolutely burning with
competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian. I've been tryin' to catch up
to you all
this time, itching to go
one-on-one at the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm the Hishi Amazon, and I'm gonna give you everything I've got, so just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You got that, Teach?! Get ready for
some
high-octane power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word of her bold declaration spreads
like wildfire
from news outlet to news
outlet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh. The Arima Kinen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set. The one-on-one we've
been
preparing for is just around the
corner. And now,
we're staring down the
homestretch.
